title: AI Assurance Dashboard - Jack & Jill

## AI Auditing and Assurance

Jack & Jill uses Warden AI to provide third-party assurance over its AI systems. Our platform continuously audits for bias and other risks, giving ongoing visibility into fairness, compliance, and system behavior. This dashboard shares key insights to help stakeholders and users understand how the AI operates in practice.

Jack & Jill - AI Candidate Matching

As a core component of Jack & Jill's AI Recruiter solution, the AI Candidate Matching feature enables organizations to find exceptional talent faster and cheaper than agency recruiters.

Candidate profiles are evaluated against a customer-defined rubric of job criteria. Each candidate is assessed individually using the same rubric, producing a consistent recommendation on whether they should be introduced to the hiring team.
